title: LUCIA'S BACKSTORY — GTA VI
label: ROCKSTAR-CONFIRMED CHARACTER
script: Lucia is more than half of GTA Six's main duo. Rockstar says fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary. Now she wants the life her mother dreamed about. Rockstar describes her as ready to take matters into her own hands. Are you more excited to play as Lucia, or Jason?
